title: Seedless Raspberry Granita
changes_from_base: Raspberries replace the strawberries, with a little more sugar and less lemon.
summary: A refreshing frozen dessert made with fresh raspberries and lemon juice for a bright, tangy finish.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Place 450 g raspberries, 180 ml water, 110 g caster sugar, 45 ml lemon juice and a pinch of salt into the blender. Process for 1-2 min until the mixture is completely smooth.

steps.title: Strain
steps.text: Pour the mixture through a fine sieve into a bowl to remove the seeds. Press firmly on the pulp so that all the liquid and flavour comes through.

steps.title: First freeze
steps.text: Transfer the liquid into a 33 x 23 cm glass dish. Place the dish uncovered in the freezer for about 1 h.

steps.title: Rake
steps.text: Use a fork to rake the frozen edges into the liquid middle. This helps create the signature icy texture of the dessert.

steps.title: Final freeze
steps.text: Return to the freezer and repeat the raking every 30-60 min for a further 2-3 h. Mash any large chunks with the fork until the crystals are light and fluffy.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Give the ice a final rake to loosen it. Pile the red crystals into chilled glasses and eat straight away.

tips: Use thawed frozen berries if fresh ones are unavailable.
Ensure you press the pulp thoroughly to get the best flavour.
Serve in pre-chilled glasses to prevent the ice from melting too quickly.
storage: Keep the granita covered in the freezer for up to 1 week and use a fork to rake the crystals before serving.
